introHtml: Zipper closures keep lunches secure and fresh, making them a practical upgrade over open totes. Whether you're outfitting a sales team with the Poly Pro Lunch Box or gifting the Igloo Day Chiller at a trade show, a zippered design prevents spills and adds a polished look. These bags also pair well with screen printing or embroidery for prominent logo placement. For safety managers and HR directors, zippered lunch totes offer durability and convenience that employees will use daily, extending your brand exposure beyond the office.
